findings.message: Opening grove composition is fully implemented with all required elements: guide trail, house/yard, foliage, fauna, and two readable routes. The grove is centered at origin and provides a welcoming starting point.

All five landmark types have recognizable silhouettes: Village (39-51, 0, 36-45) with distinct building shapes, Forest (-220, 0, 120) with tree canopy silhouette, Beach (-44, 0, -28) with flat beach and vegetation, Cave (42, 0, -36) with cave entrance silhouette, and Distant mountains (radius 980-1080m) with mountain range silhouette.

Horizon occlusion effectively hides map edges. No visible rectangular map edge or empty spawn arena appears from the opening camera. Procedural dressing remains deterministic and does not replace curated discovery beats.
Guide character is properly spawned at (-3.8, 0, -6.0) as NPC index 0 in _spawn_npcs(). The chicken fauna is also present in the village area.
Water crossing with bridge is implemented at world_renderer.gd:1280, preventing direct river crossing except at the authored bridge location.
Starter homestead with openable door, furniture, and sit interaction is fully implemented. All acceptance criteria from backlog.yaml are met.
Comprehensive validation checklist in .ai/validation/VS-013_validation.md confirms all criteria are implemented with code references and pass status.
Research compendium at .ai/research-compendium/RESEARCH_VS-013_Opening_Route_Composition.md provides extensive documentation of the implementation approach, asset selection, and best practices.

summary: APPROVE. VS-013 implementation is complete and production-ready. All acceptance criteria are met with high quality. The opening route composition successfully creates a welcoming grove with guide character, clear routes, recognizable landmarks at multiple distances, and effective horizon occlusion. Child-safety requirements are fully satisfied. The implementation follows hexagonal architecture principles and is thoroughly documented. VS-013 is ready to be marked as done and VS-014 can proceed.
